[P2] Justify and cover malformed error-metadata fallbacks

The added error tests never supply malformed JSON or non-object `errorData`. Removing this catch or the non-object fallback therefore leaves their assertions unchanged, although malformed metadata could then throw during error reconstruction instead of preserving the AI error. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the error-metadata design and either remove unreachable fallback cases or specify and test the intended reconstruction behavior.
